summary: Equip yourself with essential tools for resource mobilization in humanitarian crises. Join our training and learn to make a difference when it matters most.
lede: Humanitarian resource mobilization links assessed needs with fundable response plans and suitable funding opportunities. It is for program managers, grant and partnership officers, coordinators, and other staff involved in securing or managing resources for humanitarian responses. Participants practice mapping donors, developing budgets and proposals, and building donor relationships while connecting results and reporting to future funding.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who play a direct or supporting role in securing and managing resources for humanitarian response.
audience: Public sector and disaster management staff
Business development staff in humanitarian organizations
modules: Local Resource Mobilization and Private Sector Engagement
Risk Management in Humanitarian Resource Mobilization
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of humanitarian principles and some experience in project management or fundraising within a humanitarian context.
